newsitem.title: USA: Beazer Homes sees H1 97 earnings below 96.
newsitem.headline: Beazer Homes sees H1 97 earnings below 96.

text.p: Beazer Homes USA Inc said on Tuesday that its earnings for the first half of fiscal 1997 may be below what they were in 1996.
The company said quarterly order and earnings comparisons will be difficult in early fiscal 1997 because of interest rate increases and very strong prior-year results.
The company said, however, that a focus on improved operating profit margins has produced results and that its growth in Texas provides it with "good upside potential for the 1997 full fiscal year."
"We enter fiscal 1997 with a sense of cautious optimism," stated Chief Executive Ian McCarthy.
Earlier on Tuesday, Beazer reported fourth quarter results of $0.76 per fully diluted share, compared to $0.71 for the year-ago quarter.
In the first half of 1996, Beazer reported earnings of $0.70 per share.
Chief Financial Officer David Weiss said later that while the company thinks it might not meet that figure, it believes the 1997 second half may improve from the 1996 second half.
"It's possible, it's very possible that it will be going up, though we're not giving any indication where," Weiss said.
